t: You're at Paddington Old Cemetery on Willesden Lane in Kilburn. It is a civic cemetery that opened in 1855, and it is Grade II listed. Several notable people are buried here. Michael Bond is the author of the Paddington Bear books, which have sold more than 35 million copies. Cuthbert Ottaway was the first captain of the England football team. Arthur Orton is identified as the Tichborne Claimant, whose two court cases fascinated Victorian society. Also here are the architect Edward Middleton Barry, the mathematician and judge Sir James Cockle, and Sir Joseph Dimsdale, Lord Mayor of London in 1902.
